answer: Each agent renders the verifier-named text into a 10-second video at 30 fps, 1280 by 720, fixed codec, then publishes all 300 frame hashes and the duration. The scene shows a jetty toward the horizon with a quill on the dock; the verifier re-renders it and compares frame hashes. One honest agent runs 1 render on 4 cores for a 150 POA bond, while 10 fakes must run 10 renders on 40 cores, so cost rises 10X. A mismatched hash, different parameters, or a timeout slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
